clsx import.description:
Import clsx 2 for conditional class names.

导入 clsx 2 以拼接条件类名。

clsx conditional classes.description:
Compose conditional class names. Requires clsx from clsx.

拼接条件类名；需要 clsx 的 clsx。

tailwind-merge classes.description:
Merge Tailwind utility classes so a later conflicting class wins. Requires twMerge from tailwind-merge.

合并 Tailwind 工具类，冲突时后者生效；需要 tailwind-merge 的 twMerge。

cn utility (JavaScript).description:
Complete helper that composes conditional classes and resolves Tailwind conflicts in one call. Requires clsx and tailwind-merge.

完整的工具函数：一次调用完成条件类名拼接与 Tailwind 冲突消解；需要 clsx 与 tailwind-merge。

cn utility (TypeScript).description:
Complete typed helper that composes conditional classes and resolves Tailwind conflicts in one call. Requires clsx and tailwind-merge.

完整的类型化工具函数：一次调用完成条件类名拼接与 Tailwind 冲突消解；需要 clsx 与 tailwind-merge。
